title: Boozy Mint Frappe | Bottoms Up with Whitney Adams
description:
On today's episode of Bottoms Up!, we're making something that'll cool you down on those hot summer mornings! These mint frappes are tasty, boozy, and functional (they DO have caffeine!).

Bottoms Up! is a Makeful series about delicious and easy cocktails! Sommelier and cocktail connoisseur Whitney Adams is showing you how to put a unique spin on traditional cocktails AND have lots of fun in the process.
